'''Grenade Tower''' is an [[AIC]] [[Facilities|facility]] in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''.

{{Item description|<b>ATK</b>: {{Color|981|7}}
<b>Attack Interval</b>: {{Color|3|7}}s

A launcher of compressed Originium grenades. Designs are based on small field guns used during the Aggeloi War.}}
